title: Cyclic Vector Existence for Nonderogatory Matrices — RCF Approach

problemStatement.formal: \text{For any field } K \text{ and nonderogatory } M \in M_n(K),\ \exists\, v \in K^n \text{ cyclic for } M.
problemStatement.plain: A matrix M is **nonderogatory** when its minimal polynomial equals its characteristic
